academy_lessons.LESSON_1_SGP_RECALC_500MS: DK recomputes SGP combinability every 500ms (1000ms pre-live). The combinability matrix + dynamic odds run client-side on that clock. A recalc gap = stale SGP prices on your screen. Any bet submitted inside a recalc window can hit odds that are about to move. The 500ms cadence is THE exploitable rhythm.
academy_lessons.LESSON_2_LONGSHOT_INITIAL_DATA_OFF: isLongshotInitialDataEnabled=false: DK deliberately does NOT pre-load longshot pricing. Longshot alt-ladders load on-demand = first-request latency = the pricing you see first may be cached/stale. Longshot alt-ladders are the slowest-updated surface.
academy_lessons.LESSON_3_SGP_INHOUSE: isInHouseEnabled=true — DK prices SGP in-house (not Kambi). The combinability matrix + correlation model is DK proprietary, computed client-side. The correlation assumptions are IN THE JS (dk-same-game-parlay bundle on CDN).
academy_lessons.LESSON_4_SIMPLEBET_MICRO: Simplebet powers DK micro-markets (matchviz). Their apiKey ships in the page. Micro-market pricing = Simplebet engine + DK hold. Separate engine from Kambi/nash.
academy_lessons.LESSON_5_MOVE_THE_LINE: isMoveTheLineEnabled=true — DK alt-line sliders are a first-class product. Alt-ladder pricing cadence = the microMarketsBlink 15000ms delay window. Lines blink for 15s after moves = theDK signals line changes to users; a scraper watching between blinks sees pre-blink prices.
academy_lessons.LESSON_6_MYBETS_WS_NO_MSGPACK: My-bets WebSocket: JSON not Msgpack (isMsgPack=false), unlike the odds feed. Two protocols on the same site — odds=Msgpack over sportsbook-ws, bets=JSON over the myBets socket. Protocol split = separate RE tracks.
